# Passion for Photonics

Advanced Photonix provides innovative photonics, optoelectronics and advanced electronic systems for
Aerospace & Defence, Medical, Agricultural, and Industrial Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)
who demand high reliability, high-performance and market-driven technology solutions today.

# Our Products

#### Photodiodes

Our high-performance photodiodes and optical sensors are trusted by Aerospace and Defense, Medical &
Life Sciences, Test and Measurement, and Industrial markets.

[View Product][25]

#### Photodiode Modules

Experience the ultimate in evaluation technology with our state-of-the-art modules that seamlessly
integrate high-performance electronics with our superior photodiodes and optical sensors.

[View Product][26]

#### Light Dependent Resistor (LDR)

Light Dependent Resistors (LDR) measure visible light between 400 and 700nm. The resistance
decreases as light increases, with efficiency similar to the human eye.

[View Product][27]

#### Optocouplers / Optoisolators

Our CdS Photocell Output Optocouplers or Optoisolators are designed to connect an LED to a CdS LDR
optically. This connection allows two electric circuits to interconnect through a light-sensitive
optical interface. 

[View Product][28]

#### Optical Switches / Opto Switches

readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also

**Precision Photodiode Solutions for Demanding Optical Applications**

Our photodetectors and sensing solutions deliver high performance trusted across aerospace, defense,
telecom, and advanced scientific industries. With full in-house fabrication and engineering, we
offer unmatched precision, reliability, and the ability to customize products to exact
specifications. Since 1973, our expertise has ensured consistent performance even in the most
demanding environments.

[[Megaphone]Contact Us][48]

### [Solutions][49]

[Link to: Defense][50]
[Defense]

### Defense

We help the defense industry by providing rugged, high-reliability photodetectors engineered to
operate in extreme and mission-critical conditions, supporting applications such as laser
rangefinding, target acquisition, secure comms, and surveillance systems.

[Link to: Semiconductors][51]
[Semiconductors]

### Semiconductors

We design and manufacture high-reliability photodetectors and custom optical sensing solutions that
enable semiconductor and photonics systems used in imaging, optical communications, precision
sensing, and mission-critical electronics.

[Link to: Aerospace][52]
[Aerospace]

### Aerospace

We help the aerospace industry with rugged, high-reliability photodetectors and custom sensing
solutions engineered for extreme, mission-critical applications in navigation, imaging,
communications, and onboard monitoring.

[Link to: Optical Communications][53]
[Optical Communications]

### Optical Communications

We help the Optical Communications industry with high-performance photodetectors and custom optical
sensing solutions that enable faster, more reliable signal transmission, network monitoring, and
infrastructure performance in demanding environments.

[Link to: Industrial][54]
[Industrial]

### Industrial

GPD helps industrial customers with durable, high-precision photodetectors designed for monitoring,
automation, and quality control. Our custom sensors deliver reliable performance in harsh
environments, enabling accurate measurements that keep operations efficient, safe, and predictable.

[Link to: Bio Sensing][55]
[Bio Sensing]

### Bio Sensing

GPD supports biological inspection by providing high-sensitivity photodetectors that enable precise
optical biosensing for sorting, contamination detection, and quality grading. Our customizable
devices help manufacturers identify defects, measure composition, and maintain consistent product
safety and quality.

## [Product Categories][56]

[Link to: Photodiodes][57]
[Photodiodes Graphic]

### Photodiodes

GPD photodiodes deliver stable, low-noise, high-sensitivity detection for precise, repeatable
optical measurements, engineered for reliable performance across research, industrial, and defense
environments where accuracy is critical.

[Link to: Specialty Photodiodes][58]
[Two-Color Detectors Graphic]

### Specialty Photodiodes

GPD Optoelectronics’ specialty photodiodes—including two-color detectors and low-PDL InGaAs
devices—deliver precise spectral control, stable response, and reliable performance for demanding
optical sensing and measurement systems, with seamless integration into fiber-optic and
instrumentation environments.

[Link to: Position-Sensing Photodiodes][59]
[Quadrant Photodiodes Graphic]

### Position-Sensing Photodiodes

GPD Optoelectronics position sensing photodiodes, including quadrant and tetralateral detectors,
deliver precise beam position measurement with high sensitivity, fast response, and reliable
performance, enabling accurate alignment, tracking, and motion control in advanced optical and
industrial systems.

[Link to: Packaging Options][60]
[Mounting Configurations Graphic]

### Packaging Options

Explore GPD Optoelectronics’ packaging solutions for photodiodes and sensors, designed for reliable
performance, protection, and seamless integration, with options including precision fiber coupling
and advanced thermal and optical configurations for demanding applications.

## MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

### WE ACCURATELY MEASURE ANY OF YOUR LASERS:

#### [NEW: 40 kW Extreme Laser Probe][163]

 

EXTREME is a new Laser power probe suited for high power lasers measurements up to 40kW, without any
need for water cooling.Extreme .

#### [NEW: BLINK – THE HIGH SPEED THERMAL SENSOR][164]

BLINK High Speed is the latest LaserPoint’s Thermal sensor specifically developed to measure
ultrafast lasers up to 1 MHz rep. rate and pulse duration down to femtoseconds.

#### [NEW: Laser Pulse Controller][165]

 

Pulse Controller is a new dedicated system for laser process optimization through Pulse-to-Pulse
Energy measurement of Fast and Ultrafast Lasers
* From CW to MHz frequency
* From Long to Femtosecond pulse
* From Low to Extreme power level
* From UV to Far Infrared

**Wide portfolio** of laser power meters and laser energy meters able to perform laser measurements
up to multi-kilowatts optical power level

**Tech solutions**, unique on the market to measure your ultrashort lasers down to picosecond and
femtosecond pulse duration and high repetition rates up to MHz range.

**The best hard coatings** to absorb the laser radiation which allows its laser power and energy
sensors to safely work to the highest levels of optical power density!

02Day 2 to 3

price. You sign it. That's the contract. No 30-page SOW.

50% deposit, then I start

03Week 1+

software, not mockups. No 'imagine this on mobile.'

Working software you can touch

### Ship + 30 days support

Production deploy with monitoring. You confirm it matches the scope doc, then pay the remaining 50%.
I stay available for 30 days post-launch for questions, bugs, and rollbacks.

## Sensor solutions for repeated industrial automation tasks

XSZ sensors are used where machines need stable detection signals in compact, fast-moving or harsh
production conditions.

### Packaging Lines

Carton, bottle, bag, film, label and color mark detection.

### Machine Tools

Metal part position, tool detection, fixture checking and end-position feedback.

### Automated Assembly

Small part counting, missing-part checks, feeder monitoring and station verification.

### Logistics & Conveyors

Object presence, counting, sorting, spacing and reject station
